general.homepageDesc: Leave about:home to use the built-in start page
general.uiLocaleDesc: Polish or English — applies to the whole Vio UI
general.openSearchInNewTab: Omnibox search in a new tab
general.autoPipHint: When you leave a tab with playing video, enable PiP (Alt+P or omnibox icon).

search.resultsLangDesc: English forces English results / UI (Google, DDG, Brave…)
search.torNote1: Tor mode hides your IP and isolates the session (separate in-memory partition, no cookies shared with normal tabs). This is not Tor Browser — it does not provide the same fingerprinting protection. For sensitive work use official Tor Browser. We do not call this mode “anonymous”.
search.torNote2: On this PC: Tor Browser (desktop) for sensitive work, plus an optional local SOCKS daemon (127.0.0.1:9050 / built-in Expert Bundle on 19050). Windows daemon autostart is off by default.
search.torSocksDesc: Port 9050 is a system daemon, 9150 Tor Browser, 19050 built-in Expert Bundle
search.torDaemonAutostartHint: Shortcut in the Startup folder — only if you enable it deliberately. Off by default.
search.torOpenTabDesc: Ctrl+Shift+N — fail-closed if Tor does not start
search.torBridgesDesc: No Moat — built-in list from Tor Browser or your own lines. Changing this restarts the daemon.
search.torBridgeLinesDesc: One bridge per line (obfs4 / snowflake / meek_lite)
search.torDnsNote: DNS: with SOCKS5, Chromium sends hostnames to the proxy (≈ socks5h). New identity: Ctrl+Shift+U — closes Tor tabs, wipes the session, SIGNAL NEWNYM. Per-domain SOCKS Auth isolation is unavailable in Electron.

look.themeAccentHint: Turn off to set a custom color
look.pageAppearanceDesc: Separate from browser theme — dark chrome won’t break light sites

sidebar.panelWidthDesc: Or drag the right edge of an open panel
sidebar.name: Name

privacy.presetHint: Standard protects against ads and trackers but leaves SSO, YouTube, payments, and CAPTCHA working. Strict is stronger and may break sign-in / banking — then use the shield or Adblock exceptions.
privacy.thirdPartyCookiesDesc: Strict blocks all — may break sign-in on some sites
privacy.stripTrackingHint: Removes campaign tags from links; skips banks and sign-in
privacy.dntHint: In Strict mode — most sites ignore it anyway
privacy.clearOnQuit: Clear data when quitting the app
privacy.httpsOnlyDesc: In Strict mode enforces secure connections and warns on HTTP
privacy.dohDesc: In Standard mode uses secure DNS with a fallback server
privacy.webRtcDesc: Limits local IP leaks on video calls
privacy.fingerprintHint: In Strict mode — may break CAPTCHA and banking
privacy.searchSuggestHint: Off in Strict — local history only
privacy.allowAppNetwork: Allow list updates and app network
privacy.exceptionsNoShieldSummary: Disabled from the omnibox shield popup
privacy.noExceptions: None — add from the page shield.
privacy.resetSettingsLabel: Restore default settings, bangs, and shortcuts
privacy.resetSettingsConfirm: Restore default settings, bangs, and shortcuts?

adblock.enableHint: EasyList, EasyPrivacy, uBlock, and Peter Lowe lists
adblock.levelDesc: Standard skips first-party. Strict also applies explicit same-domain filters.
adblock.cosmeticHint: Hides ad elements on the page
adblock.listsLoading: No list data — engine still loading.
adblock.exceptionsHelp: These domains are not blocked by adblock — sign-in, CAPTCHA, and payments work normally. Privacy protection (shield) is separate.
adblock.builtinsLoading: Load the engine to see the default list.
adblock.noCustomExceptions: No custom exceptions — add a domain below.
adblock.customRulesSummary: EasyList syntax — one rule per line

home.headline: Headline
home.widgetsHint: Recent / notes / resources — add a widget from the home FAB (or below).
home.widgetResourcesHint: CPU / RAM — sampled only when visible

perf.lazyTabsHint: At startup, inactive session tabs sleep until first click. A link opened in the background loads immediately; after visiting, the tab stays alive (like Chrome).
perf.discardTabsHint: Unmounts the webview after idle time. Skips: active, Tor/private, audible tabs, and dirty forms. Dev: localStorage.vio-discard-ms (ms).
perf.discardAfterAria: Idle time before sleeping a tab
perf.discardKeepPinnedHint: Pinned tabs stay in memory (context-menu Sleep still works)
perf.bgThrottleHint: Slows tabs when the window is minimized / covered
perf.lowPowerClockHint: Updates every 30 s + pauses when the window is hidden
perf.blockHeavyMediaHint: Less autoplay / heavy assets in the UI
perf.spellcheckHint: pl + en-US (disabled in Tor windows — dictionaries are not fetched outside the Tor network)
perf.restartHint: Some changes (GPU, scroll, process limits) require a full app restart.

advanced.proxyValue: system — Tor only on Tor tabs
advanced.shortcutsNote: Shortcuts: Ctrl+, settings · Ctrl+B sidebar · Ctrl+T tab · Ctrl+L omnibox · Shift+Esc task manager.
advanced.allowInspectHint: F12 / Ctrl+Shift+I always open DevTools. This toggle only controls the context-menu item.
advanced.automationEnabled: Allow Soul to control the browser
advanced.automationHint: Local 127.0.0.1 server for the Soul assistant (normal tabs only; Tor, private, and internal pages are unavailable). On first connect Vio will ask for consent.
advanced.devCollabNote: Fetches changes from Git (fetch / pull --ff-only). Hidden in the built .exe.
advanced.checkRemote: Check remote and show new commits
advanced.downloadChanges: Fetch (ff-only) + npm ci if needed + restart
advanced.devPullConfirm:
Fetch {{n}} commit(s){{authors}}?

Will run: git pull --ff-only, optionally npm ci, then restart.
advanced.updatesNote: The built .exe checks public Releases (see docs/REPO.md). Download runs in the background; install only after “Restart to install”.
advanced.updateDownloaded: Update downloaded. Click “Restart to install” to apply it.
advanced.updateAvailable: Update found — downloading in the background…
advanced.resetAllLabel: Restore factory settings, bangs, and shortcuts

passwords.shellMissingBefore: The password manager only works in the Electron window (IPC). Open the app with
passwords.shellMissingAfter: , not Vite alone in a browser.
passwords.masterHint: Minimum 8 characters. It can’t be recovered — remember it.
passwords.rememberHintSetup: Key protected by Windows DPAPI (safeStorage). Anyone with access to this Windows account can then open the vault without the master password.
passwords.rememberHintUnlock: DPAPI — anyone with access to this Windows account can open the vault.
passwords.autofillHint: HTTPS only, strict origin, no cross-origin iframes.
passwords.offerSaveHint: Bar after submitting a login form.
passwords.autoLockHint: After idle time and when the system sleeps.
passwords.importHint: Chrome / Edge / Firefox / Bitwarden — columns url, username, password.

resources.metricsMissing: No metrics from the main process (shell:metrics).
resources.samplingHint: Only while this view / task manager / home widget is open
